name: Mark Webber
features: tanned skin, dark hair under a white team cap, dark stubble, angular face, tall lean build, wry smile
bio: Australian, nine Grand Prix wins over twelve Formula One seasons before joining Porsche's return to Le Mans; the 2015 World Endurance champion in the 919 Hybrid with Bernhard and Hartley, and a straight talker in and out of the car.
